hypotheses.rationale: After scrape_wikipedia_tables returned an empty result at step 4, the agent pivoted to printing raw page text instead of verifying whether the target table exists on the specified Wikipedia page and, critically, whether that page contains the 2018 population figures needed. Had the agent switched to a robust method (e.g., pandas.read_html) or manually locating the table section and extracting the chinstrap row, the correct Wikipedia number would have been obtained and the downstream difference calculation would be correct.
